question: Who among the following was the founder of Raigarh gharana of Kathak?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Raja Chakradhar Singh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Raja Chakradhar Singh** was the founder of the Raigarh Gharana of Kathak.
 
• He was the ruler of Raigarh in the state of Chhattisgarh.
 
• Raja Chakradhar Singh was a connoisseur of arts and a patron of classical dance and music.
 
• Under his patronage, the Raigarh Gharana of Kathak flourished, and he encouraged the blending of traditional Kathak with other forms of Indian classical dance and music.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kathak**

 
 
• Kathak is one of the eight major forms of Indian classical dance.
 
• The word 'Kathak' is derived from the Vedic Sanskrit word 'Katha' which means "story", and the Kathakars (storytellers) would narrate stories through dance, music, and songs.
 
• Kathak is characterized by intricate footwork, spins (chakkars), and expressive gestures and facial expressions.
 
• The dance form originated in North India and has three main gharanas (schools) – Lucknow, Jaipur, and Banaras, along with the Raigarh Gharana founded by Raja Chakradhar Singh.
 
 
 
• **Raigarh Gharana**
 
 
• The Raigarh Gharana is known for its unique style that incorporates elements of both the Lucknow and Jaipur Gharanas.
 
• It emphasizes a combination of elaborate footwork, rhythmic patterns, and graceful movements.
 
• The Gharana also includes compositions that integrate classical music and dance, contributing to a rich cultural heritage.
 
• Raja Chakradhar Singh's contributions to the Raigarh Gharana have had a lasting impact on the development and popularity of Kathak dance.
